description: A single Polymarket outcome's executable depth within max_price_impact_pct (default 5.0%) of the best quote, both before and after discounting the top-of-book level's size by haircut_pct (default 10.0%) to model the risk that the very best resting order gets cancelled before you can trade against it. Does not detect or flag actual spoofing (out of scope). Accepts either a raw token_id or a market_slug (+ outcome) to resolve it automatically. Paid in USDC on Base.

haircut_pct.description: Percent to discount the top-of-book level's size by, modeling cancellation risk. Defaults to 10.0.

market_slug.description: Exact Polymarket market slug, used to resolve token_id automatically.

max_price_impact_pct.description: Price-impact bound (percent of best quote) within which depth is summed. Defaults to 5.0.

outcome.description: "yes" (default) or "no" - which side to resolve when using market_slug.

token_id.description: The outcome's CLOB token_id / asset_id, if already known.

name: prediction.liquidity_depth_after_haircut
